title: These Generals Fought for Israel. Now They See ‘Jewish Terrorism’ as the Threat.
summary_full: A growing number of former Israeli generals, intelligence officials and prime ministers are accusing settlers in the West Bank of committing ethnic cleansing with government support. “Once a society behaves this way,” one said, “that society is doomed.”
